identity.title: High-z [OI] emission lines: COLDSIM simulations and ALMA observations

paper_type_evidence.quote: We post-process the outputs of the COLDSIM cosmological simulations with the DESPOTIC model, taking into account [OI] 63 μm self-absorption by cold foreground material.

evidence.quote: multiple images in which we also detect [OI] and [CII] emission at $z=4.680$

question.value: How do [OI] 63 and 145 micron emission lines in high-z galaxies relate to SFR and H2 content, and how much does foreground self-absorption of [OI]63 matter?

evidence.quote: We investigate the connection between [OI] emission lines and key galaxy properties, such as star formation rate (SFR) and H$_2$ content.
We include archival data from ALMA project 2023.1.01450.S targeting the ${\rm [OI]}\, 145 {\mu \rm{m}}$ emission for four galaxies at $z\gtrsim4.7$.

evidence.quote: The line intensity is then attenuated by a factor of $(1-e^{-\tau_{\rm fore}})/\tau_{\rm fore}$.

findings_qualitative.value: Self-absorption reduces [OI]63 by factor 2-4; needed to match observed line ratios

evidence.quote: modeling self-absorption is essential to reproduce the observed line ratios successfully.

claims.hypothesis: Foreground self-absorption of [OI]63 is needed to match high-z line ratios
claims.experiment: COLDSIM+DESPOTIC with self-absorption model compared to observations
claims.result: [OI]63/[CII]≈1 and [OI]145/[CII]≈0.2 consistent with z>~6 data only with self-absorption

evidence.quote: consistent with $z\gtrsim 6$ observations, but only when ${\rm [OI]}\, 63 {\mu \rm{m}}$ self-absorption is included.

claims.hypothesis: [OI] lines trace SFR and molecular gas
claims.result: Both lines correlate with SFR and H2 mass with flattening at high Mstar/metallicity
claims.finding: Good tracers in normal star-forming galaxies

evidence.quote: Both [OI] lines correlate with SFR and molecular mass, but exhibit flattening in scaling relations with metallicity and stellar mass.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Self-absorption model without velocity condition overestimates absorption (~90%) at high SFR

evidence.quote: where the effect is likely overestimated ($\approx 90 \, \%$ of the flux is self-absorbed)

limitations_admitted.value: Simulation volume cannot sample SFR>~100 Msun/yr systems typical of observed high-z sources

evidence.quote: Due to the limited volume of our simulation, we cannot sample highly star-forming systems ($\gtrsim 100 \, M_\odot/{\rm yr}$)

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA analysis is minimally documented and uses natural weighting with Gaussian fits only
Self-absorption model is simplified and not validated against [OI]63 detections beyond one object
H2 masses from [CII] conversion introduce circularity
